what: Placebo test of the likely ranges of the two trade parts (paid: purchases from Russia; sold: sales to Russia) and their sum: the method rerun as if the war had started in 2018 (and in 2014). The truth is zero, so coverage = the share of countries whose likely range contains zero.

settings.expected_level: paid: base year held flat at window prices; median of the window where purchases were under EUR 1bn a year (as build_data.py small_flow_base). sold: base year held flat (the method's linear nowcast is not reproducible from the repository).
settings.bands: cumulative 90% no-war bands for the number of years summed (H4; H2 in the short variant): cf_bands.json, with to_rus L/M from to_rus_cf.json, pipeline buyers from fuel_volume_cf.json, own bands for MNG/YEM/TJK/MDA from cf_bands.json countries, Belarus's yearly band from belarus.json; size class from the 4-year average before the placebo (S < 0.1, M 0.1-1, L > 1 EUR bn). sold: the random-walk band (matching the held-flat centre); variant 'site band' uses the lin band where the site uses the nowcast.
settings.data_ranges: each country's 2021 actual-value and price-level ranges in site/data.json (years_lo/hi, pidx_lo/hi as factors on the central value), applied to every placebo year; site medians where missing
settings.prices: fixed-weight fuel-mix index (energy2.json 2019-2021 mix; gas left out for the ten gas-hidden importers) from IMF commodity prices in EUR (Brent for crude, products and other fuels; EU gas, or Japan LNG for JPN/KOR/TWN/CHN/IND; Australian coal); other goods: Eurostat EA import prices, industrial goods excluding energy. Window mean = 1. Each year's change is valued at that year's price level.
settings.weights: paid at Russia's net gain share (site/data.json to_rus.gain, its 2021 value, with its range); sold at the value kept (c.vk rl/rx), as earned3()
settings.combination: site/index.html spread(): base and actual values correlated 0.5, price, no-war band and gain-share terms independent, square root of the sum of squares; paid and sold combined with correlation 0.2 (RHO paid|sold) as total()
settings.ranked: placebo GDP (mean of the first three placebo years) >= EUR 5bn, excluding Belarus and North Korea (parties to the war)
settings.size: large = purchases plus sales with Russia >= EUR 1bn a year in the pre-war window, else small
